description: Bornes de recharge de - Bayonne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Bayonne. Location of electric vehicle charging stations managed by the city of Bayonne and located on the public highway. Collection context These charging stations for electric vehicles are positioned on the public domain and managed by the city of Bayonne. The dataset does not include charging stations located inside the working car parks. Coverage: Ville de Bayonne. The portal shows the English title as "Electric vehicle charging stations - Bayonne" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Bayonne. Its keywords include stationnement, mobilier-urbain, donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2019-05-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
